---
title: Install
description: Install the gtm-sandbox skill into Claude Code, ZCode, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or any Agent-Skills-compatible tool.
---

The skill follows the open [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) format — one
`SKILL.md` works everywhere. What differs per tool is the discovery path, and
whether you also get the **slash commands** (`/sandbox-init`, `/sandbox-join`,
`/secrets-sync`), which ship only with plugin installs in tools that support
plugins (Claude Code, ZCode). Everywhere else, `SKILL.md` documents the manual
equivalent of each command.

First, clone the repo:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nika-loki/paydirt.git
cd paydirt
```

<Tabs items={['Claude Code', 'ZCode', 'Codex / Cursor / Gemini', 'Any other tool']}>
  <Tab value="Claude Code">

  Plugin marketplace — you get the skill **and** the slash commands:

  ```bash
  /plugin marketplace add nika-loki/paydirt
  /plugin install gtm-sandbox@paydirt
  ```

  </Tab>
  <Tab value="ZCode">

  Plugin Marketplace → **Add** → paste this repo's `plugins/` directory, then
  install **GTM Sandbox**. You get the skill and the same slash commands as
  Claude Code.

  </Tab>
  <Tab value="Codex / Cursor / Gemini">

  Install for a specific tool by name (slash commands are not available on this
  path — use the skill's manual equivalents):

  ```bash
  ./install.sh --tool codex
  ./install.sh --tool cursor
  ./install.sh --tool gemini
  ```

  </Tab>
  <Tab value="Any other tool">

  Auto-detect every installed agent and install for all of them:

  ```bash
  ./install.sh            # auto-detects installed agents
  ./install.sh --list     # show every known tool and its skills directory
  ./install.sh --remove   # uninstall
  ```

  Known tools: `agents`, `claude`, `codex`, `zcode`, `cursor`, `gemini`. Without
  `--tool` or `--all`, the installer targets every detected tool and always
  includes the cross-tool default `~/.agents/skills`; `--all` installs for every
  known tool, detected or not.

  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## What lands where

The installer copies the skill from `plugins/gtm-sandbox/skills/gtm-sandbox/`
into each tool's skills directory (for example `~/.codex/skills` for Codex).
Marketplace installs additionally provide the commands from
`plugins/gtm-sandbox/commands/`.

<Callout type="warn">
  Nothing in this repo ever needs a credential to install. If an install path
  asks you for secrets, that is not this repo's installer — stop and report it
  per <code>SECURITY.md</code>.
</Callout>
